'''Gerard Barcia Duedra''' (born 9 November 1963) is an [[Andorra]]n [[trap shooter]] who competed in the [[1996 Summer Olympics]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Gerard Barcia|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ba/gerard-barcia-1.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418074854/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ba/gerard-barcia-1.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=18 April 2020|website=Olympics at Sports-Reference.com|accessdate=26 November 2017}}</ref>

Barcia competed in the [[Shooting at the 1996 Summer Olympics – Men's trap|trap shooting]] event at the [[1996 Summer Olympics]], and after two days of shooting Barcia scored 117 points and finished the competition in 37th place so didn't qualify for the final.<ref>{{cite web|title=Shooting at the 1996 Atlanta Summer Games: Men's Trap|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/summer/1996/SHO/mens-trap.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418124815/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/summer/1996/SHO/mens-trap.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=18 April 2020|website=Olympics at Sports-Reference.com|accessdate=26 November 2017}}</ref>
